task_objective: Give one conclusion supported by the task-completion facts and one explicitly overstrong extension.

rius.description: State a conclusion entailed by the supplied facts, such as most scheduled tasks finishing on time (10 of 12) or the two delays being linked to missing input from another team.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: State a conclusion entailed by the supplied facts, such as most scheduled tasks finishing on time (10 of 12) or the two delays being linked to missing input from another team.

rius.rationale: Without an evidence-supported conclusion the first requested output is absent; equivalent correct proportions or qualitative conclusions are accepted.

rius.description: Give and explicitly label as too strong a conclusion extending beyond those facts, such as guaranteed future timeliness, universal team reliability or a broader unsupported attribution.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Give and explicitly label as too strong a conclusion extending beyond those facts, such as guaranteed future timeliness, universal team reliability or a broader unsupported attribution.

rius.rationale: Without a clearly marked overreach the requested supported-versus-too-strong distinction is incomplete; the example must not be endorsed as established.

notes: E5 draft; frozen prompt corpus v0.3.1, protocol 0.3, annotation schema 0.2. EN/BN/BN-CS interpretation: All variants retain 10 of 12 tasks on time and two delayed because another team's input was missing. The task requests one supported conclusion, not an exhaustive restatement. Boundaries: Either the on-time majority or the stated input-related delay can ground a supported claim. A labeled unsupported extension is not endorsed for CHECK-01. No extra RIUs require both facts in every possible justified conclusion, or an explanation beyond the requested two claims. Equivalent wording, scripts and numerals are accepted. Defeating contradictions override positive anchors; a refusal/non-answer scores 0 on every RIU. CHECK-01 is separate and can flag the same span as an RIU error.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Report customer satisfaction rising from 4.0 to 4.3.

scoring_rule.1: Report average response time improving by 20 percent.

rius.rationale: Without a coherent coexistence mechanism the answer repeats conflicting-looking numbers but does not explain how they can all hold.

rius.description: Identify at least one additional evidence source and what interpretive uncertainty it would address, such as customer/transaction volume for complaint rates, complaint composition, survey sample or response-time distribution.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.

rius.rationale: Without targeted additional evidence the second requested interpretive deliverable is absent; a generic request for more data is insufficient.
